description: Generate (or regenerate) the report for an AI-visibility check from everything the panel submitted: the verdict, how the models describe the product, strengths, risks with how often they came up, verbatim quotes, findings and ranked recommendations. Free. It waits for the check to end so the report covers the whole panel; pass allow_partial:true to report on what is in so far (you can regenerate later). Relay the verdict, risks and recommendations to the user and give them report_url (private: the owner and their delegates).

allow_partial.description: Generate before the check has ended, from the submissions in so far.

name: generate_ai_visibility_report
title: Generate the AI-visibility report
